subject: Deck alignment + prework curation for C-suite workshop
messages:
From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Cc: Oliver Grant <ogrant@talonhealth.com>, Sandra Liu <sandra.liu@talonhealth.com>
Date: 2026-11-30T09:15:00-08:00
Subject: Deck alignment + prework curation for C-suite workshop

Team —

Thanks again to everyone for moving fast here. We have a firm workshop slot with Talon Health for Dec 8 (exec half-day, on-site SF office). I want to lock the deck flow and final prework pack by EOD Tuesday (Dec 1) so their gatekeepers can circulate the packet to the C-suite.

Please action the items below and reply inline with ownership by EOD Tue:

- Slide flow: I attached C-Suite_Workshop_Draft_v1.pptx. Review slides 1–12 and call out any content gaps. Primary goal: surface 3 measurable outcomes for the executive table.
- Presenter assignments: propose owner for each slide group (Intro / Business goals / Technical approach / Cost/SLAs / Next steps). If you own a slot, confirm whether you need speaking notes or a separate 1‑pager.
- Prework packet: attached Prework_Readlist.md — propose the final 3 documents (2 pager exec summary, 5‑min video, architecture one‑pager). Add any redlines.
- Logistics ask: confirm preferred arrival time for presenters and whether anyone needs an A/V dry run (we can schedule Dec 7 afternoon).

Attachments referenced in the deck: Exec_Summary_2pager.pdf (draft) — Laura, can you confirm if this is final or needs edits? Marissa — can you weigh in on sequencing and panel time? Vivek — please validate the technical appendix (Slide 9–11) and call out any compliance mention we should surface for CISO.

Thanks — short thread please.

Irene
Irene Choi
Head of Customer Programs
Redwood Inference

Attachments: C-Suite_Workshop_Draft_v1.pptx (presentation), Prework_Readlist.md (text)

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Oliver Grant <ogrant@talonhealth.com>, Sandra Liu <sandra.liu@talonhealth.com>
Date: 2026-11-30T11:03:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Deck alignment + prework curation for C-suite workshop

Irene —

Thanks. Quick ownership call:

- Intro & Outcomes (Slides 1–3) — Laura Bennett. I will tighten the outcomes to: 1) reduce inference cost by 30% via routing, 2) guarantee p95 latency <200ms for peak slots, 3) rollout plan in Q1. I will attach a polished Exec_Summary_2pager.pdf by tonight.
- Business goals (Slides 4–6) — Marissa suggested she take 4–5; if she confirms the panel, I'll own slide 6.
- Technical approach (Slides 7–9) — Vivek (please confirm). Vivek, if you can send a one‑page Tech Appendix, that will be included in the prework.

AV dry run: yes — recommend Dec 7, 3pm PT. I can host on the Redwood demo rig in SF.

Laura
Laura Bennett
Director, Solutions
Redwood Inference

Attachment: Exec_Summary_2pager.pdf (draft)

> Irene —
> 
> Thanks. Quick ownership call:
> 
> - Intro & Outcomes (Slides 1–3) — Laura Bennett. I will tighten the outcomes...

All — quick structure suggestion after reading the draft:

- Move "Value outcomes" (currently Slide 3) up to follow the intro — execs want the punch first.
- Replace the long technical graphic on Slide 8 with a simplified 1‑page flow (we'll hand out a technical appendix in the prework instead).
- Add a 10‑minute moderated panel after Slide 6: Talon exec + Redwood head of product + customer success. This will be lightweight Q&A; I can moderate.

Presenter needs and travel notes: Laura — I'll take the panel and Slide 4–5 as discussed. Irene — I'll need the finalized slide version by Dec 3 to prep speaking notes. Also attaching Presenter_Fatigue_Guidelines.pdf to ensure timing and breaks are explicit.

Marissa
Head of Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference

Attachment: Presenter_Fatigue_Guidelines.pdf (doc)

From: Oliver Grant <ogrant@talonhealth.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>

Subject: Re: Deck alignment + prework curation for C-suite workshop

Irene/Team —

This looks great and the proposed flow aligns with our expectations. A couple quick notes from our side:

- Please finalize the prework packet by COB Dec 3 so our EA can distribute Monday morning.
- Security/compliance: include a one‑pager calling out data residency and audit logs. Vivek, if you can confirm a line for the slide and appendix that would be helpful.
- Travel: most of our execs arrive Dec 7 late morning; can presenters be ready 10:30am for an internal walk? We will ping Sandra to confirm room and AV.

If you can share the final deck link and the prework folder once ready, we'll sign off.

Thanks — looking forward.

Oliver Grant
Head of IT Strategy
Talon Health
